posts.name: Silvan Mosberger
posts.raw: Also, remembering the attempted [Packages Modules WG](https://discourse.nixos.org/t/working-group-member-search-module-system-for-packages/26574), arguably the main problem with using something like the module system for packages was performance. @DavHau [experimented with this idea](https://matrix.to/#/!djTaTBQyWEPRQxrPTb:nixos.org/$muE2XE-sj2n-9LsM88zq6L3Mttk3z0opDb5-zYyShsE?via=nixos.org&via=matrix.org&via=nixos.dev) by making `mkDerivation` use the module system, and determined that evaluation was 2-3x slower. Shouldn't come at a surprise though, the module system does much more with its type checking and co, but we considered that a blocker for the scale of Nixpkgs.
